state.verified_grammar: GRAMMAR.md line35: newline ends logical line at depth zero; balanced ()[]{} join physical lines and continuation indentation has no layout meaning; mismatched closer or unclosed delimiter is error. Lexer strings stop at physical newline and diagnose E1006. Parser owns per-declaration attempt/recover, losslessly wrapping each LogicalLine on failure.
state.verified_implementation: layout.rs first accumulates tokens in pending while bracket stack nonempty; only zero stack flushes normal LogicalLine. At EOF E1102 diagnoses innermost unmatched opener and wraps entire pending range. Parser therefore cannot see later independent declarations. Current five witnesses: schema {value:int, call count(, list M {value:int[]=[1, unterminated string inside schema, and a later top-level app. Each swallows subsequent derive a(): int = 1 + true and derive b(): int = nope; audit retains coverage true but misses E3002/E2001.
state.constraints: Preserve every currently balanced multiline delimiter input, including same/dedented continuation and closer lines, descriptions inside schema, string punctuation, nested schema/list/call, new state-machine syntax and nested do/if suites. Keep all original byte spans and CST full coverage, E1102 anchor on actual opener and E1006 on string. state.uncertainty: Malformed unclosed delimiter plus later same/dedented expression can be an unfinished continuation or independent declaration. No algorithm can infer authors intent uniquely. Balanced input must keep full meaning; invalid-input fallback semantics must be explicit and bounded. More-indented unfinished continuations should stay in their malformed owning line. Choice does not claim recovery if unrelated later delimiter accidentally balances malformed join or arbitrary deeply indented survivors.
state.proposed_mechanics: Option late_fallback is layout-owned replay only of final pending EOF-unclosed join. Ordinary balanced prefixes are committed unchanged. Once definite EOF failure established, replay that suffix using same token/delimiter rules but at each next nonblank/non-## physical code/description line with indent <= current pending logical start and stack nonempty: diagnose E1102 at innermost remaining opener, flush pending into malformed owning logical line, clear stack, process boundary line normally. Deeper continuation stays joined; balanced subjoins encountered during replay keep normal semantics. Retain one error diagnostic per abandoned join and full tokens/comment ordering; no keyword classification.

recovery.instructions: Which bounded recovery mechanism best satisfies the same verified contracts and scope, weighing valid-input preservation, independent diagnostics, ambiguity and ownership cost equally?

criteria.late_fallback: Perform bounded EOF-failure-only layout replay as described. Avoids changing all valid balanced joining and exposes sibling/dedent boundaries only for a provably malformed final join. Risk: same/dedented unfinished continuation can become multiple recovery lines, and accidentally balanced malformed joins are outside bounded support. Linear extra pass only on incomplete suffix, no grammar engine duplication.
criteria.eager_boundary: Reset delimiter stack before same/dedented physical line as soon as detected. Restores nearby siblings without replay and catches accidental later balances, but would split legal balanced continuations/closers at equal/dedented indentation contrary to current grammar, requiring changed language admission or syntax classifier to avoid it.
criteria.parser_driven: Record physical line boundaries on joined LogicalLines and let owning parser recover after declaration failure, transactionally retrying subsets to discover independent grammar-admitted siblings. Can retain flexible indent and recover accidentally balanced malformed joins, but needs richer CST/layout interface, precise cursor/builder/diagnostic rollback, contextual grammar retries and treatment of unfinished valid fragments; larger shared parser ownership lease and complexity.
criteria.defer: Leave current EOF join and report only E1102 until a fuller editor recovery specification exists. Preserves valid grammar and avoids ambiguous recovery choices but keeps demonstrated swallowing of independent declarations and their safety/type/name diagnostics.
